key_entities: Summary Content The Consumer Price Index
root_nodes.summary: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) for Ethiopia in June EFY2017 showed a year-on-year inflation rate of 13.9%, down from 19.9% in June EFY2016. The month-on-month inflation rate increased by 0.5% in June EFY2017, compared to 0.9% in June EFY2016. The Food and Non-Alcoholic Beverages component recorded a year-on-year inflation rate of 11.7% for the same period.
